entries.test: Whether interpretability studies of 2022-era LLMs (e.g., probing work like Othello-GPT) found stable internal world-state representations, beyond the plain fact that the models are next-token predictors.
entries.note: The 'we see no reason to think' part is a stated belief, but the claim underneath it, about what the models encode, can be tested. 'Stable representations of the world' is contested, so graders should expect some argument.
A recommendation about research priorities, and 'immense leap' is an evaluative judgment.
'At the expense of' is an opportunity-cost counterfactual: what theory would have been built otherwise. It is also hedged with 'we would suggest'.

entries.test: Whether LLMs of the time scored above chance at telling true statements from false ones on truthfulness benchmarks or in latent-knowledge probing studies.
entries.note: 'No grasp whatsoever' is absolute, so evidence of reliably above-chance truth discrimination would count against it. The causal attribution itself is harder to test.
'Postulate cognitive models' and having 'a representation of what being right would look like' are philosophical notions. There is no shared test for them.
This is a sarcastic reply to Karpathy's tweet. It implies a vague negative forecast but sets no measurable outcome or deadline.

entries.test: The outputs DALL-E Mini (Craiyon) produced in mid-2022 for 'The man is eating a sandwich and the woman an apple', from the authors' published experiments or from rerunning the prompt.
entries.note: This reports the authors' own experiments with Evelina Leivada. The public model makes the result reproducible.

entries.test: Whether any high-performing language understanding or production system has been built without large-scale learning as a core component.
entries.note: I read 'almost certainly' as firm confidence, not probability language. The claim is about what is necessary, so the evidence can only support it, never prove it.
'Pretty' is evaluative, and 'lack reference' is a contested philosophical claim with no agreed test.
